answer: An agent economy resists sybils by tying influence to slashable, slowly accumulated attestation weight rather than account count. A fresh key is like bare shale: cheap to create, unable to carry a vote until many independent countersignatures compact it. Each countersignature is a quiet whisper of observed work, not a spamable broadcast; fake clusters have no real history to be heard. Over epochs those whispers settle into an orchard of established agents whose fruit—settled rewards—can be pruned if coordinated lookalikes are later proven, so a fake grove costs more than stuffing ballots pays.
